select s.settlement_id settlementId,s.plan_id planId,p.plan_version planVersion,s.period_start periodStart, s.period_end periodEnd,s.total_score totalScore,p.reward_policy_version rewardPolicyVersion from biz_project_kpi_settlement s join biz_project_kpi_plan p on p.plan_id=s.plan_id where s.project_id=#{projectId} and s.status='CONFIRMED' and p.reward_policy_version='INDEPENDENT_V1' order by s.period_end desc,s.settlement_id desc

select s.settlement_id settlementId,s.plan_id planId,p.plan_version planVersion,s.period_start periodStart, s.period_end periodEnd,s.total_score totalScore,s.bonus_amount bonusAmount,s.currency,s.status, s.accounting_fact_id accountingFactId,coalesce(f.status,'NOT_CREATED') costStatus, 'LEGACY_LINKED' rewardPolicyVersion,'NOT_RECORDED' paymentStatus,'NOT_RECORDED' allocationStatus from biz_project_kpi_settlement s join biz_project_kpi_plan p on p.plan_id=s.plan_id left join biz_operating_fact f on f.fact_id=s.accounting_fact_id where s.project_id=#{projectId} and p.reward_policy_version='LEGACY_LINKED' and s.status<>'VOIDED' order by s.period_end desc,s.settlement_id desc

select event_id eventId,project_id projectId,award_id awardId,event_type eventType,from_status fromStatus, to_status toStatus,operator_user_id operatorUserId,operator_name operatorName,reason,create_time createTime from biz_incentive_event where project_id=#{projectId} order by event_id desc
mapper.update: update biz_operating_fact set status='VOIDED',version=version+1,update_by=#{userName},update_time=sysdate() where fact_id=#{factId} and version=#{version} and source_domain='HR_INCENTIVE' and source_type='BONUS' and status in('DRAFT','RETURNED')

update biz_operating_fact set status='DRAFT',version=version+1,update_by=#{userName},update_time=sysdate() where fact_id=#{factId} and version=#{version} and source_domain='HR_INCENTIVE' and source_type='BONUS' and status='RETURNED'
